Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: Misread the ATP page and confused Jorge Lozano’s doubles peak (No. 4) with his singles peak; the ATP page shown clearly listed his singles career-high as No. 51 (1988-09-12). This led to the incorrect conclusion that Lozano had the better singles ranking, whereas Roberta Vinci’s singles career-high was No. 7 (May 2016), which is higher.
